settings.subtitle: The main protection and app behaviour settings

save.restarted: Saved. The tunnel restarted with the new settings.
save.restartFailed: Saved, but the tunnel did not restart
save.nextConnect: Saved. Takes effect at the next connection.

connection.title: Connection
connection.sourceHint: Direct VPN runs our sing-box straight to the server and does not use Happ's routing rules.
connection.sourceDirect: Direct VPN key in VPNTE (no Happ)
connection.directTitle: VPN servers are managed on the Servers page
connection.directText: Paste a subscription URL or a protocol key (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, hysteria2://, happ://add/…) — the server list is saved automatically. The server selected there is used when you connect.
connection.hardHint: Tunnel (TUN) — all Windows traffic goes through the tunnel
connection.softHint: Proxy — the Windows system proxy points at the app's engine; programs that ignore it go direct
connection.softTargetsHint: While Proxy mode is on, the chosen tools use the proxy too; their settings are restored when it stops.
connection.bypassHint: Sites and addresses that programs open directly, bypassing the proxy. One per line.
connection.bypassAuto: Add sites that go direct anyway
connection.engineHint: «Auto» picks Xray for REALITY and TLS keys (Xray has the current TLS fingerprint), Xray transports, provider Xray configs and pinned certificates, and sing-box for the rest and for keys with settings only sing-box has (mux, dial options); the engine is shown next to the server. «xray-core only» refuses protocols Xray lacks (TUIC, NaiveProxy, AnyTLS, ShadowTLS) instead of switching engines silently. A single server's engine is set in its «…» menu.

protection.title: Protection
protection.disguiseTitle: Other programs cannot see that you use a VPN
protection.disguiseNow: Now: games, banking clients and websites often refuse to work when they notice a typical «VPN connection» in the system.
protection.disguiseThen: With it: your link looks like an ordinary home network, without tell-tale VPN marks. Most such checks no longer trigger.
protection.disguiseAuto: Works automatically every time protection is on — no separate switch needed.
protection.leakHint: While protection is on, IPv6 and DNS outside the tunnel are blocked by Windows filters. Network adapters are not changed.
protection.wifiHint: Until the tunnel is up, the router's DNS stays reachable (captive portals), and a safe MTU is used for hotspots.
protection.autoRestart: Restart the engine after a crash
protection.autoRestartHint: If the engine process dies unexpectedly, we try to restart it up to 3 times with an exponential pause.
protection.stealthHint: Now: the provider sees the protected stream as a «typical VPN» and may slow it down or drop packets. With it: the stream looks more «ordinary» and is harder for filters to recognise. Helps when pages hang, video stutters or sites load «every other time» although the internet seems to work. Cost: a couple of percent of speed and a slightly longer first response. If protection is already on, it applies at once (the tunnel restarts automatically), otherwise at the next start.
protection.adaptiveHint: Connects normally first. If the check through the VPN fails, switches on a compatibility mode once and remembers what worked, on this computer only.
protection.geo: No online geo lookups in the app
protection.geoHint: The app will not send the current VPN IP or the selected server's IP to ipapi.co, geojs.io, ipwho.is, ipinfo or iplocation. This does not change sites like 2ip.ru: they still see the country of the IP you visit them from. A country already stored for a profile or taken from its name may remain as a local hint.

location.label: Hide the Windows location
location.hint: While protection is on, Windows apps get no geolocation; everything returns when it is off.
location.hiddenBody: Apps are denied access to geolocation. Rolled back automatically when the VPN is turned off.
location.restoredBody: Maps, Weather and other apps can determine your location again.
location.willHide: The Windows location will be hidden
location.nextConnect: Takes effect at the next connection.
location.wontHide: The Windows location is no longer hidden
location.notApplied: The location setting did not apply
location.notAppliedBody: Windows did not allow the change; a system location policy may be holding it.
location.failed: Could not change the location setting

browser.label: Browser WebRTC protection
browser.hint: Stops browsers from sending WebRTC traffic around the proxy, so sites cannot learn your real IP through WebRTC.
browser.restart: Restart the browsers for the change to take effect.

smartRu.title: Smart Russia mode
smartRu.splitHint: Now: all traffic goes through the VPN, and Russian sites (banks, Gosuslugi, marketplaces) see a foreign IP — this causes captchas, logouts and «login from abroad» blocks. With it: Russian services that are really hosted in Russia or are on the narrow government/maps lists open with your real address, and everything else still goes through the VPN. Russian destinations are recognised by the IP country (geoip-ru) and targeted domain lists, not by «.ru», so YouTube/Google are not sent directly together with broad «popular in Russia» lists.
smartRu.splitNote: The built-in lists work offline; auto update, when on, uses the app's download route. Changes take effect at the next protection start.
smartRu.mapsHint: Yandex Maps, 2GIS and Google Maps tiles go directly, so they show you where you really are, not in the VPN country.
smartRu.listsHint: The app uses ready lists from the installer. They can be updated automatically; if an update fails, protection keeps working on the built-in lists.
smartRu.autoUpdateHint: Try to download fresh rules once a day through the app's download route. On failure the built-in lists stay.
smartRu.refreshNeedsAuto: Downloaded lists are used only with auto update: turn it on and save the settings to update by hand.

killSwitch.statusEngaged: Traffic outside the VPN is blocked
killSwitch.offLine: If the VPN stops, programs go online directly.
killSwitch.onDropLine: If the VPN drops by itself, the internet pauses until it is back. Disconnect and Quit work as usual.
killSwitch.onDropProxy: Applies to programs that use the system proxy (browsers and most apps).
killSwitch.alwaysLine: No internet without the VPN, even after Quit or a restart: the VPN connects when Windows starts. Local network keeps working.
killSwitch.alwaysAsOnDrop: Needs the helper service; works as “If the VPN drops” meanwhile.
killSwitch.firewallBlock: Windows Firewall blocks outgoing connections by default. If the VPN does not connect, allow the VPN engines in the firewall.
killSwitch.hyperv: Virtual machines and WSL use their own network: the kill switch does not cover them.
killSwitch.broadHint: A very wide address range: a large part of the internet bypasses the kill switch.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.autostartHint: Start the app when you sign in to Windows.
behaviour.autostartUnconfirmed: Windows did not confirm the autostart change: the actual state is shown.
behaviour.tray: Minimise to the tray on close
behaviour.trayHint: The X button hides the app in the tray instead of quitting. Protection keeps working in the background.
behaviour.autopilotHint: At start it decides by itself: leave things as they are (if an external VPN already works) or turn on Tunnel mode.
behaviour.enrichmentHint: Fetches the title and description of a domain's HTTPS page through the active VPN. Results are stored locally; without the VPN no new requests are made.

rotation.directOnlyHint: Rotation works only for Direct VPN.
rotation.directOnly: Rotation works only for Direct VPN
rotation.noneAvailable: None of the listed servers is reachable now
rotation.failedRestored: Could not switch the server: {{reason}}. The previous server was restored.
rotation.failedNotRestored: Could not switch the server: {{reason}}. The previous server was not restored.
rotation.noServers: No servers yet: add them on the Servers page.

dns.autoHint: DoH to 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 through the tunnel
dns.addressHint: An IP address, https://…/dns-query (DoH) or tls://host (DoT). Queries always go through the VPN.
dns.selectFailed: Could not switch the DNS profile: {{reason}}

domains.patternHint: example.com — the domain and all its subdomains; *.example.com — subdomains only; ~word — any name that contains the word.
domains.hitsTitle: Connections whose name matched the rule's pattern
domains.orderHint: A higher rule is checked first; change the order with the ↑ ↓ buttons.
domains.orderSmartPins: Pinned rules of Smart Russia mode
domains.orderSmartDirect: Russian services of Smart mode (government, maps) — directly
domains.orderUser: Your «Direct» and «VPN» rules — top to bottom
domains.overridesDirect: Smart RU would send this site direct; your rule applies
domains.overridesVpn: Smart RU would send this site through the VPN; your rule applies
domains.importSkipped: Skipped: {{duplicates}} duplicates, {{invalid}} invalid, {{over}} over the limit

notifications.masterHint: Notifications about protection starting, engine failures and IP leaks. Protection messages inside the app are always shown.

transfer.redacted: A file without secrets: profile passwords and keys must be entered again.
transfer.consumed: This file has been used. To try again, pick the file again.

advanced.modeHint: Opens Repair and the advanced options: manual proxy address, the app's download route and rarely needed network options.
advanced.wizardHint: Opens now; settings change only if you complete it.
advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.proxyHint: Overrides Happ auto-detection. Leave empty to detect automatically.
advanced.proxyCredentials: Saved login and password are not shown; a new value replaces the whole address (login:password@host:port).
advanced.proxyType: Proxy type of the manual address
advanced.bootstrapHint: Used to update subscriptions and Smart-RU lists. It does not change how your traffic goes through the VPN.
advanced.bootstrapAuto: Auto: subscriptions directly, then through the VPN; Smart RU lists through the VPN while connected
advanced.fallbackHint: After a failed check of the compatibility mode, Direct VPN may try another server of the same group once. A server you picked by hand is not changed.

capture.title: Deep traffic capture (packet level)
capture.hint: Records an extended Windows network trace with pktmon during a protected session. Raw captures stay on this computer only.
capture.maxSizeHint: Ring buffer. When the limit is reached, old packets are overwritten.
capture.quotaHint: Only the latest session goes into the diagnostics ZIP; raw .etl files are not included.
capture.clearText: All stored capture sessions will be deleted from this computer.
capture.consentText: The capture records whole packets; unencrypted data (for example HTTP) may end up in files on this computer.
capture.unavailable: Deep traffic capture is not available in this version.

tools.title: Logs and diagnostics
tools.hint: The folder with the app journal and the engine logs; an archive for the developer with logs and settings without secrets.
tools.exportFolderAdvice: Choose a local personal folder such as «Documents». Shared and network folders and drives without ACLs may not be supported.
tools.cleanupFailedBody: Temporary diagnostics files could not be deleted.

demo.adaptiveConnected: Connected in the normal mode, the check through the VPN passed.
demo.adaptiveFailed: The check through the VPN failed even in the compatibility mode.
demo.adaptiveVerifying: Checking the connection through the VPN…
demo.badApp: A full path to an .exe on a local drive is needed, for example C:\Program Files\App\app.exe.
demo.badIp: An IP address or a network is needed, for example 192.168.1.0/24.
demo.dotless: Enter a domain with a dot (telegram.org) or a keyword with ~ (~telegram).

launch.label: Connect at start
launch.hint: At start the app connects by itself: to the last used server, or to the fastest of the best three (checked one at a time, never a burst of handshakes). If you already connected or disconnected yourself, it does nothing.
launch.notChosen: You have not chosen yet: off.
launch.providerOff: You have not chosen yet: the provider of the last server's subscription asks not to connect at start.
launch.providerLastUsed: You have not chosen yet: the provider of the last server's subscription asks to connect to the last used server.
launch.providerLowestDelay: You have not chosen yet: the provider of the last server's subscription asks to connect to its fastest server.
launch.providerRandom: You have not chosen yet: the provider of the last server's subscription asks to connect to a random server of it.
launch.hintProxy: Works when you connect through a server from the list. With a local proxy the route autopilot decides at start.
